reviews.text: Riccie came exactly when the dispatcher said he would. He worked diligently to resolve the issue in the rain and mud. He gave me an honest opinion of the condition of our hot water tank and was able to make the repairs needed to get us by for a few more years.  He also was able to repair our bathroom faucet that I had attempted to fix in the past. Great friendly service. I would highly recommend.

Nickolas was terrific.  Professional, knowledgeable and very easy to converse with.  This was the second time we had him out to address the same issue but went with a more permanent solution that we probably should he's done the first time.  Setting up the appointment was a simple and timing was flexible.  Our issue was not serious so we chose next day but they would have come out the evening the issue arose.  Cannot recommend this company and Nickolas enough!!!

Was super impressed with the speed. From the time of my call - they arrived within 20 minutes ! They were also thorough in explaining the problem and repair options. They also got the necesssary "green tags" (permitting) before back filling (completing) the repairs. It was more expensive than I anticipated - but pretty confident the repair was done properly the first time. Thank you John !

Tony was awesome and did a great job. He explained everything to me step-by-step and showed me the camera video to see what exactly was going on.
